# Position 101: 30 0b - SEQUENCE of length 11 (our new AlgorithmIdentifier)
# Position 103: 06 09 - OID
# Position 104-112: 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 0a - id-RSA-PSS
# Position 113: 30 00 - empty SEQUENCE (parameters)
# Position 115: 30 00 - this is wrong! Should be BIT STRING (0x03)

# The issue is that the original had:
# 101: 30 0d - SEQUENCE of length 13
# 103: 06 09 - OID
# 104-112: 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 01 - rsaEncryption
# 113: 05 00 - NULL
# 115: 03 - BIT STRING

# I replaced bytes 101:116 (15 bytes) with new_algo (15 bytes)
# But the original AlgorithmIdentifier was at 101:116 (15 bytes)
# Let me verify

print(f"Original cert bytes 100-120: {bytearray(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.DER))[100:120].hex()}")
print(f"Modified cert bytes 100-120: {cert_der[100:120].hex()}")

# The original: ... 30 0d 06 09 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 01 05 00 03 ...
# Position:    100 101 102 103 104 105 106 107 108 109 110 111 112 113 114 115 116

# 102: 0d (length 13)
# 103: 06 (OID)

# 116: 03 (BIT STRING)

# 104: 09 (length 9)
# 105-113: 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 0a (id-RSA-PSS)

# 115: 00 (length 0)
# 116: 03 (BIT STRING - this is correct!)

# Wait, but the output shows:
# After replacement, bytes 100-120: 22300b06092a864886f70d01010a300030000500
# Position:                         100 101 102 103 104 105 106 107 108 109 110 111 112 113 114 115 116 117 118 119 120
# 
# 100: 22
# 101: 30 0b 06 09 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 0a 30 00
# 115: 30 00 - wait, this is wrong!
# 
# Oh, I see the issue. The original bytes 100-120 were:
# 22 30 0d 30 0b 06 09 2a 86 48 86 f7 0d 01 01 0a 30 00 05 00 03
# 
# Wait, that doesn't look right either. Let me re-examine.

# Actually, I think the issue is that the original certificate already had
# the RSA-PSS OID! Let me check the original certificate again.

orig_cert_der = cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.DER)
print(f"\nOriginal cert bytes 95-125:")
print(f"  {orig_cert_der[95:125].hex()}")

# Let me decode this properly
# The TBSCertificate structure is:
# SEQUENCE {
#   [0] EXPLICIT Version,
#   INTEGER serialNumber,
#   SEQUENCE signature,
#   SEQUENCE issuer,
#   SEQUENCE validity,
#   SEQUENCE subject,
#   SEQUENCE subjectPublicKeyInfo,
#   ...
# }

# Let me find the subjectPublicKeyInfo
# It should contain: SEQUENCE { AlgorithmIdentifier, BIT STRING }
